messages:
incident-bot: pagerduty alert — INC12345 fired: /generate-canary 5xx spike (p95 latency ↑, error pattern auth/token_expiry). autopage to #eng-oncall. PD: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC12345

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty page fired to on-call: @maya. If not acked in 2m escalate to @sam.

maya: Acked. I'm on it — starting with logs/traces.

sam: pulling traces now. seeing auth-service token introspect returning 502/503, only in canary. last deploy included token-refresh changes (rev r23fa).

leo: quick grep shows new header format in r23fa — expiry header went from int -> string, looks like downstream lib parse fails.

maya: can we disable the new token-refresh feature flag on canary and see? token-refresh-v2. if errors drop we can rollback the release.

sam: doing flag flip now: `redwood flag set token-refresh-v2 false --env=canary`

system-bot: feature-flag updated: token-refresh-v2=false (env=canary) by sam

maya: restarting canary auth pods to pick up the change: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-service -n canary```

leo: tailing logs: `kubectl logs -f deploy/auth-service -n canary` — watching for residual 5xxs.

monitoring-bot: ALERT RESOLVED (automatic): canary /generate 5xx rate dropped from 4.1% -> 0.5% within 2m after flag flip. p95 latency trending back to baseline. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/canary/generate

maya: looks effective. holding rollout. no escalated customer tickets in support, only transient retries observed. tagging @karen for handoff.

sam: root cause hypothesis: PR r23fa changed expiry header type -> auth lib attempted string parse -> nil/exception -> 5xx. plan: revert the serialization change or add tolerant parsing. I'll prepare a hotfix PR and run canary tests.

maya: mitigation steps agreed: 1) keep token-refresh-v2=false in canary 2) halt rollout to prod 3) roll back code change if hotfix not ready in X hr 4) create incident doc & timeline.

karen: taking overnight handoff. summary for pagerduty/ops: canary deploy with token-refresh-v2 caused token-introspect failures -> ~0.4% of /generate requests returned 5xx for ~7 minutes. mitigated by disabling FF + pod restart. no data loss, some client retries. logs archived: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/INC12345/

maya: adding links: PR r23fa: https://git.internal/redwood/changes/r23fa, incident doc: https://confluence.internal/redwood/incidents/INC12345, PD: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC12345

karen: I'll monitor dashboards and run periodic checks. escalate to SRE lead if error rate >1% or if more than 5 customers report issues. ping me directly for urgent escalation.

maya: thanks everyone — will close PD when incident doc and PD note are updated. :thumbsup:
